title: Knee-pathology gait signature in real GaitRec ground-reaction force

dataset.name: GaitRec
dataset.record: vertical GRF (left+right), healthy controls (HC) vs knee-pathology (K)
dataset.citation: Horsak B, et al. GaitRec, a large-scale ground reaction force dataset of healthy and impaired gait. Sci Data. 2020;7:143.

proposition: On real GaitRec vertical ground-reaction force, the ecosystem reproduces the knee-pathology gait signature versus healthy controls: a reduced first (loading) peak (1.019 vs 1.116 BW) and a raised mid-stance trough (0.836 vs 0.744 BW) — the flattened GRF double-hump of reduced weight-acceptance modulation.

validation.reference: GaitRec cohort contrast (HC vs K) and the established clinical GRF-modulation pattern
validation.data: REAL — GaitRec vertical GRF, n_control = 180, n_patient = 178 (K), BW-normalised, 0-100% stance
validation.note: The reduced loading/push-off peaks and the raised mid-stance trough in the K group reproduce the expected reduced weight-acceptance modulation of pathological gait. GaitRec provides no joint kinematics/timing, so no ICC/knee-angle claims are made here (those tracks are synthetic in the source and are excluded).

open_questions.q: None escalated: this reproduces an established clinical GRF pattern on public data. Joint-kinematics reproducibility is out of scope for GaitRec (not measured).
